changes: DELIVERY (this blocks the edit call): post 5 is kind "text" in channel-posts.json, so editMessageCaption will fail on it. Use editMessageText with parse_mode HTML and send reply_markup (the buttons) in the same call. Also pass link_preview_options {is_disabled:true}, because the old text had a URL and Telegram could keep showing its preview. The bot needs can_edit_messages in @kasb_egalari.

Title kept from the corrected version: one sentence, no emoji, no dash. The original's hook idea and all three professions stay, with the catalog names Videograf, Montajor and Grafik dizayner (src/lib/categories.ts:54,55,67).

'Ro'yxatdan o'tish bepul. Birinchi 30 kun profilingiz katalogda bepul turadi.' is unchanged. The catalog line needs the 30-day condition because subscriptionEnforced=1 is the default (constants.ts:189-191) and the site uses the same idea (PlanCards.tsx:93).

Optional suggestions not applied, to keep the edit minimal: joining the 'Yozish' line onto the catalog line; adding 'ijodiy va onlayn' (no longer needed now that the 'kasb egalari uchun' phrase is gone); a t.me startapp deep link for the button (the plain https URL is the allowed fallback).

Checks: 4 body lines; 435 characters including tags and tail (428 without); no em or en dashes; ASCII apostrophes only; no emoji; no competitors, invented numbers, 'hech kim', 'hammasi', 'ko'pincha' or 'Bepul profil'.

Site inconsistency, not in this caption: Kabinet → Portfolio tells every user '30 tagacha' (src/app/kabinet/portfolio/page.tsx:21,51; src/lib/i18n/dict/kabinet-forms.ts:288), but Standart is capped at 12. That page should show TIER_LIMITS[premiumTier].portfolio.

captionHtml: Montajni kimdan o'rgansangiz, tezroq o'sasiz? So'rovnoma ochsa, ovoz berasiz. • Ustoz bir darsni bepul namuna qilib qo'ysa, uni kursga yozilishdan oldin ko'rasiz. • Barcha darslarni tugatib, testlardan o'tsangiz, sertifikat olasiz. • Montajni yaxshi bilsangiz, mentorlikka ariza berasiz. Admin tasdiqlagach, kurs ochasiz. #ustoz Ro'yxatdan o'tish: @kasb_egalari_bot

Becoming a mentor: replaced the 'mumkin' hedge with the real condition. You apply, and you open a course only after admin approval (mentorship/service.ts:53-65).
Replaced every em dash (—) with a comma or a period. Bullets start with a capital letter and end with a period.
Removed the old end block (URL and the ⚡/👉/📢 lines). The caption now ends with '#ustoz' + 'Ro'yxatdan o'tish: @kasb_egalari_bot'.

Button: 'Mentorlikni ochish' -> /mentorlik. The page is a real route ((katalog)/page.tsx), but the «Ustozlar» row shows only when an approved mentor with a slug exists, and prod could not be checked. Length is 563 characters with HTML and 556 as plain text. The body has 6 lines. No em or en dashes, all apostrophes are ASCII.
BEFORE EDITING: in a browser, check that /mentorlik shows at least one course. If admin → Tizim holati shows LiveKit configured, line 1 can go back to 'ustozlar kurs ochadi va jonli efir o'tkazadi'.
